column1: # The hand-written part of the Japanese keyboard's emoji keywords, part of this project (data/emoji/README.md).
# keyword <TAB> emoji (or kaomoji) <TAB> ..., best first, at most five; or keyword <TAB> skip (a CLDR keyword left out).
# A keyword is a reading in hiragana (わら) or a word as the conversion writes it (笑い, ハート);
# the strip offers its emoji for a reading that is it, or converts to it. A line here takes the
# place of CLDR's for the same keyword.
ありがとうございます
おめでとうございます
よろしくおねがいします
